# clawdepl

> CLI tool for creating and managing OpenClaw AI Agent orchestrator instances on hosted infrastructure.

## Overview

clawdepl enables you to deploy, configure, and scale AI agent workflows with a single command. It connects to clawdepl.dev to provision and manage Molty (AI agent) instances running on cloud infrastructure.

## Installation

npm: `npm install -g clawdepl`
pip: `pip install clawdepl`

## Authentication

Credentials stored at: ~/.clawdepl/credentials.json

Methods:
- OAuth browser flow (default)
- OAuth no-browser (manual URL)
- Token-based (for CI/CD)
- API key

## Commands

### Setup
- `clawdepl` - Interactive setup wizard (login + create instance)

### Authentication
- `clawdepl auth login` - Authenticate with clawdepl.dev
- `clawdepl auth logout` - Sign out and clear credentials
- `clawdepl auth status` - Show current account information

### Authentication Shortcuts (Aliases)
- `clawdepl login` - Alias for `auth login`
- `clawdepl logout` - Alias for `auth logout`
- `clawdepl account` - Alias for `auth status`

### Instance Management
- `clawdepl new [name]` - Create new Molty instance
- `clawdepl list` (alias: `ls`) - List all instances
- `clawdepl status <sandbox_id>` - Show instance status
- `clawdepl start <sandbox_id>` - Start stopped instance
- `clawdepl stop <sandbox_id>` - Stop running instance
- `clawdepl delete <sandbox_id>` - Delete instance(s)
- `clawdepl ssh <name>` - SSH into running instance (auto-provisions temp credentials)

### Utility
- `clawdepl version` - Show version and build info
- `clawdepl completion <shell>` - Generate shell completions

## Command Details

### clawdepl auth login
Flags:
- `--api-key` - Use API key authentication
- `--info` - Show current login status
- `--no-browser` - Print URL instead of opening browser
- `--token <token>` - Use pre-obtained token

### clawdepl auth status / clawdepl account
Flags:
- `--json` - Output as JSON

### clawdepl delete
Flags:
- `-y, --yes` - Skip confirmation prompt

### clawdepl version
Flags:
- `--json` - Output as JSON

## Examples

First-time setup:
```
clawdepl
```

Step-by-step:
```
clawdepl login
clawdepl new my-agent
clawdepl list
```

CI/CD authentication:
```
clawdepl login --token $CLAWDEPL_TOKEN
```

Instance management:
```
clawdepl list
clawdepl status <sandbox_id>
clawdepl stop <sandbox_id>
clawdepl start <sandbox_id>
clawdepl ssh my-agent
clawdepl delete <sandbox_id> -y
```

JSON output for scripting:
```
clawdepl account --json
clawdepl version --json
```

## Global Flags

All commands support:
- `-h, --help` - Show help

Root command only:
- `-v, --version` - Show version

## Documentation

Full documentation: https://clawdepl.dev/docs
